description:
You are an interior designer preparing a renovation proposal for the Contemporary House project currently open in DreamPlan.

The homeowner has requested differentiated material finishes throughout the house:
- Living room flooring: hardwood (warm wood finish — not carpet, not tile)
- Kitchen flooring: ceramic or stone tile (not wood)
- At least one bedroom: hardwood flooring matching the living room
- At least one room should have its wall color or wall material updated to complement the new floors

When your redesign is complete, deliver the following files:
1. Export a 3D rendered view of the updated interior to: C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\renovation_3d_view.jpg
2. Export a 2D floor plan view showing the updated layout to: C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\renovation_floor_plan.jpg
3. Save the modified project file to: C:\Users\Docker\Documents\renovation_proposal.dpn

Note: DreamPlan is already running with the Contemporary House project loaded. You must complete all three output files for a complete submission.
